item.title: ai: Announcing Azure AI Speech LLM 09-2026: Broader locale support
item.description:
Azure AI Speech LLM 09-2026 adds broader locale support and claims improvements in multilingual quality and latency. The post positions the update as an expansion of supported language/locale coverage.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: ai: Announcing Azure AI Speech LLM 2607: Better Multilingual Accuracy, Easier Customization
item.description:
Azure AI Speech LLM 2607 adds improved multilingual and mixed-language recognition, lower latency, and simpler domain-specific customization through enhanced phrase lists. The release focuses on accuracy and customization for speech recognition workloads.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog
